EditTextPreference.android:title: Emby Server URL
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Use an https address, e.g. https://emby.example.com (plain http is blocked)

EditTextPreference.android:title: Emby sign-in token or API key

Preference.android:title: Sign in with a regular Emby account (recommended)
Preference.android:summary: Safer than an administrator API key: the phone then holds only the token of an ordinary Emby user, and the password is never stored. Needs plugin 1.9 or newer.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Ask for the phone's screen lock
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Before the app opens, ask for your PIN, pattern or fingerprint, so nobody else can add time or end a time-out. Also hides the app in the recent-apps view.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Alert me when someone reaches a limit
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Keeps a small connection to your server open in the background and shows a notification with +15/+30/+60 buttons (they ask for your screen lock first). Uses a little battery; some phones need the app excluded from battery optimisation for this to stay on.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Hide names on the home-screen widget
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Shows User 1, User 2 ... instead of names, for a widget that others can see.
